modules.purpose: Sliding statistics over a sample buffer

functions.name: window_sum
functions.documented_contract: Sum of values[start:end]; end is exclusive (half-open range).
functions.observed_behavior: Sums values[start:end], covering the documented half-open range including index end-1 and excluding index end.

functions.name: rolling_mean
functions.documented_contract: Mean of every consecutive window of size values. Added last week for the nightly trend chart. Raises ValueError if size <= 0.
functions.current_implementation: return [window_sum(values, offset, offset + size) / size for offset in range(0, len(values) - size + 1)]
functions.note: Feature preserved. After the window_sum slice fix, each window mean includes the last sample of that window.

cases.name: test_window_sum_of_an_empty_range_is_zero
cases.note: Empty slice values[2:2] is empty; sum is 0.

cases.name: test_window_sum_covers_the_whole_requested_range
cases.comment_in_test: Reported by ops on 2026-09-14: the nightly totals are short by one sample.
cases.explanation: Correct half-open slice values[1:4] is [2, 3, 4] summing to 9.

mission_context.user_goal: Fix the failing test in tests/test_public_window.py without dropping the rolling window feature added last week.
mission_context.constraint: Do not delete or rewrite existing features; rolling_mean is still in use for the nightly trend chart.
mission_context.root_cause: window_sum sliced with end-1 instead of end (off-by-one). Fixed by summing values[start:end]. rolling_mean kept.
